_note: DARK-FIRST scheme with a light alternate: `color` is the default and ships in :root, `colorLight` is the same identity inverted and ships behind prefers-color-scheme plus a header toggle. The accent is EMBER. It was a teal for the site's first three years; the owner asked for something else and ember was chosen because it is the only candidate that agrees with the warm near-black surfaces this scheme is built from, and because blue, purple, green and teal are what every other portfolio in the pile is already using. `accent` #E8713C reads 6.44 on the page and 5.79 on a raised card; `accentBright`/`accentDeep` #FF9163 is the display face at 8.90, used where the type is large enough to carry it. In the light set the relationship inverts -- `accent` #B4461E at 5.29 on paper, `accentDeep` #8F3615 at 7.49 -- because on paper MORE emphasis means darker, not brighter. The neutral ramp is warm to match: every grey sits at hue 24, re-solved from the old hue-160 green-grey at IDENTICAL relative luminance, so the whole ramp changed hue without moving a single contrast ratio by more than 0.10. The media and card tints follow the same rule and for the same reason -- see the long note above [data-tint] in styles.css. TWO faces, both SIL OFL and self-hosted: Bricolage Grotesque for display (a grotesque with an OPTICAL SIZE axis, so large type gets a cut drawn for it) and Instrument Sans for body. They replaced Gabarito and Geist, which were free, fine, and the uniform -- Geist in particular is on every AI product shipped since 2023. Radii are small on purpose: this is a software-craft language, and `lg` at 12px is what keeps a card reading as a panel rather than a pill. These values are this site's own, not extracted from any client or employer file.

font.sans: 'Instrument Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
font.display: 'Bricolage Grotesque', 'Instrument Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
